source_note: All measured production source hashes match the candidate commit. The benchmark hash separately identifies the shared-workspace timing protocol.

protocol.host: Python entry to Python return; device synchronization outside timer; separate AB/BA loop per CPU metric; 101 samples
protocol.public: Warm public call including winner-cache lookup, validation, pack and launch. Cold selection is pinned to the same tactic before timing.
protocol.graph_cpu: One replay of an uninstrumented 50-call graph, in microseconds per replay; not divided by 50
protocol.gpu: External events in a separate 50-call graph; microseconds per MoE call; both sides use identical input/workspace addresses; snapshots checked against independent buffers
protocol.scope: Component host/GPU microbenchmark; no model throughput claim

correctness: All compared outputs bitwise equal between baseline/candidate and public/replay after changing routing IDs and scores. Separate tests use independent numerical references.
